主要内容: Waters Corporation announced its results of operations for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2017. A copy of the related press release is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 to this Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference in its entirety. The press release provides details on the company's financial performance for the specified periods, including revenue, net income, and other key financial metrics. The results are reported in accordance with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). The announcement is part of the company's regular reporting cycle and does not include any forward-looking statements or projections. The financial results are intended to provide investors with an understanding of the company's operational and financial performance during the periods indicated.
